Great to meet you both. Attached is a first-pass MAP for StellarSys ("MAP_StellarSys_v1.xlsx"). High-level highlights:

Milestones and target dates:
- M1: Pilot kickoff & environment access - owner: StellarSys Platform (Sarah) - target: 2026-03-17
- M2: Pilot validation & performance checkpoints - owner: StellarSys/Redwood SE (Aditya) - target: 2026-03-24

- Redwood: deliver pilot config, performance benchmarks, MAP updates, and commercial terms.

- Target commercial: looking to present a discounted committed price + onboarding credit to align procurement.

Please review the MAP and let me know edits. I will loop in pricing for a formal approval once you confirm the target commit/usage numbers. If end-of-month close works for you, we'll prioritize the M3 approvals.

Subject: Internal: StellarSys pricing request / discount ask
Attachments: pricing_sheet_redwood_v4.pdf

Marissa - quick internal note after Sarah's ask. StellarSys indicated procurement will push for a 20% off list for first year to match an incumbent discount. They also asked about any onboarding credits for migration/testing.

Baseline: standard committed discount for mid-market is 15% for 12-month reserved capacity + standard onboarding (included).

Options to propose to execs:
1) Approve 15% off list + $25k onboarding credit contingent on signed 12-month commit and reference agreement (preferred)
2) Approve up to 18% off + $10k credit if they push for a lower revenue commit
3) Approve 20% + $0 credit only if they provide a 24-month commit and minimum ARR threshold (stretch)

I recommend option 1 - preserves price discipline and gives them a tangible onboarding incentive. If you agree, I'll open a pricing approval and include the MAP and hubspot deal (DEAL-5543).

-Aditya
(SE for Redwood)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-12T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Internal: StellarSys pricing request / discount ask

Thanks for the context. Approve option 1 with the following conditions:
- 15% discount off list for year 1 on a 12-month committed Dedicated plan
- $25,000 onboarding credit to be applied during Q1 implementation (one-time credit)
- Customer must agree to provide a short technical case study and a reference call within 6 months of go-live
- Legal to review T&Cs; CS (Stephanie) to validate ramp plan and resource availability

Marissa - please present the commercial terms to the customer as part of the MAP update and let procurement know these are contingent on the 12-month commit + the reference ask. If procurement pushes back materially, escalate to me.

Vivek
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
